card.name: First item in a list of categories
card.fires_on: A word naming one member of a category, such as a type of organism, spectrum band, religion or ocean, often early in a list or after 'including' or 'such as'. It also fires partway through some names.

modes.label: Category member in a list
modes.description: A member of a set such as fungi, infrared or Christianity right after a list-opening phrase or comma.

modes.label: Modifier naming a type
modes.description: An adjective naming a kind or origin before a noun, such as fungal, brown or Indian.

modes.label: Partway through a name
modes.description: Inside a longer name or term, such as germanium or technetium.

card.plain: It marks a word that names one kind among several, such as fungi among microbes or infrared among light types.
